jobs.occupation: We seek nurses for permanent positions in Snåsa in Norway
jobs.description: Would you like a permanent nursing position with varied responsibilities and nature right outside your door?On behalf of Snåsa Municipality in Trøndelag, Norway, we are seeking three registered nurses for permanent positions within the municipal healthcare and care services.Here, you will enjoy a varied and meaningful workday, providing care and follow-up for patients both in home care services and in institutional settings. You will become part of a professional healthcare environment where nurses play a key role, with a high degree of autonomy, varied clinical responsibilities, and close collaboration with colleagues and other healthcare professionals.At the same time, you will have the opportunity to live in a place where nature is never far away. Snåsa is located next to the Blåfjella-Skjækerfjella National Park, offering vast forests, mountains, and excellent opportunities for hiking, cycling, hunting, and fishing. With a population of approximately 2,100 people, Snåsa is also a welcoming community where it is easy to get to know people and feel at home.About the positionAs a Registered Nurse, you will have a varied workday caring for patients with different needs in both home care services and institutional care settings.Typical responsibilities include:    Providing daily nursing care and professional follow-up to patients in home care services and/or institutional care    Observing, assessing, and documenting patients’ health conditions    Medication administration and treatment in accordance with applicable guidelines and regulations    Collaborating with other healthcare professionals, family members, and multidisciplinary teams    Contributing to quality improvement initiatives and the development of local routines and patient care pathwaysThe position involves shift work, including day, evening, and weekend shifts. You will have a significant level of professional responsibility and will work both independently and closely with other professional groups. High-quality, safe patient care is at the heart of everything, while maintaining a positive working environment built on collaboration, well-being, and good humor.QualificationsWe are looking for someone who is professionally engaged, responsible, and enjoys working both independently and as part of a team.    Authorization as a registered nurse in an EU or EEA country    Good communication skills in English and willingness to learn Norwegian    Valid police clearance and health certificate including tuberculosis and MRSA before starting    Valid driver’s licence (Class B)    Professionally engaged and responsible    Strong teamwork and adaptability skills    Experience from elderly care, home care services, or rehabilitation is an advantageWe offer    Permanent employment with competitive terms and conditions    Free Norwegian language training provided    A stable and predictable working environment    Varied and meaningful nursing responsibilities    A supportive and collaborative team environment, including guidance when needed    Excellent opportunities for professional development and continuing education    Attractive municipal pension and insurance schemes through KLP    Additional compensation for evening, night, and weekend work    Support and follow-up from Dignus Medical throughout the application and employment process    Support with housing and relocation when neededLife in SnåsaSnåsa is located in the northern part of Trøndelag, along the E6 highway and the Nordland Railway, approximately 50 minutes from Steinkjer. The municipality has around 2,100 residents and is ideal for those who wish to live close to nature while being part of a small and welcoming community. The area offers an active sports and cultural scene, shops, cafés, and excellent opportunities for outdoor activities all year round.For those relocating with family, the municipality offers good capacity in kindergartens, schools, and after-school programs, as well as a variety of leisure activities for children and families. Trondheim Airport Værnes is approximately two hours away by car, and the Nordland Railway also provides convenient transportation to and from Snåsa.Interested?Feel free to contact us for more information or submit a short application today!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

In NordRen departement Asker, we have 23 trucks. Some are small Volvo and Iveco single-operator trucks, while the larger ones are Scania three-axle trucks with two-person crews. The trucks have two compartments: One for paper and one for plastic, one for food and one for residual waste.

Each two-person crew handles between 300 and 350 stops per day, meaning they empty around 600–700 bins daily. All bins are equipped with RFID chips, which are scanned by antennas on the lifting mechanism during collection. This records the chip number, time of collection, and waste type and kilos of waste

We empty approximately 1.8 million waste containers on an annual basis.

On average, we empty about 7000 - 7500 containers per day, totaling around 36 000 containers per week.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

We are looking for reliable, positive and flexible people who are ready to contribute during a busy and exciting hotel season.

You enjoy working with people, take responsibility and understand the importance of excellent guest service.

Good spoken and written English is required for all positions. Norwegian is a significant advantage, particularly for reception, supervisory and other guest-facing roles.

Relevant experience is required for supervisory and senior kitchen positions. For several other roles, motivation, reliability and the right attitude may be just as important as formal qualifications.

⚠️ RIGHT TO LIVE AND WORK IN NORWAY

All applicants must already have the legal right to live and work in Norway at the time of application and must maintain this right throughout the agreed employment period.

Applicants from outside the EU/EEA must hold a valid Norwegian residence permit granting them the right to work in Norway when applying. Being eligible to apply for a permit is not sufficient. A residence permit issued by another European country does not automatically grant the right to work in Norway.

EU/EEA citizens must comply with applicable Norwegian registration requirements.

Applicants must provide documentation of their right to live and work in Norway with their application. Applications from candidates who do not meet these requirements will not be considered.

No employee may start work without the necessary legal right and valid documentation.

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

✨ A unique season in beautiful Hardanger

✨ A professional and international working environment

✨ Competitive pay based on experience and responsibility

✨ A proper Norwegian employment contract

✨ Training and support

✨ Staff accommodation available for rent, subject to availability

✨ Staff meal arrangements

✨ Opportunities to develop and return for future seasons

IMPORTANT AVAILABILITY INFORMATION

As we are a seasonal hotel, applicants must be available throughout the agreed employment period.

Employees should not expect to take holidays during the operating season. Any planned holiday or absence must be disclosed during recruitment and discussed and approved in accordance with Norwegian legislation and the hotel's staffing requirements.

HOW TO APPLY

Send your CV and a short application in English.

Please include:

• The position you are applying for

• Relevant experience and references

• Your English and Norwegian proficiency

• Confirmation of your availability for the season

• Confirmation of your legal right to live and work in Norway

• Your nationality and current residence/work permit status, where applicable

Please write the position you are applying for in the email subject line.

Applications will be reviewed continuously.

jobs.occupation: Kayak Guide – Summer in Reine, Lofoten
jobs.description:
Want to spend your summer paddling on the world-famous Reinefjorden, working outdoors and guiding guests through some of Lofoten's most spectacular scenery?

Reine Rorbuer is looking for a certified kayak guide for a 50% position during the busiest part of the summer season.

What we offer:

• 

Work in the heart of Reine

• 

Spend your working days outdoors on the fjord

• 

Meet guests from all over the world

• 

Join a small, friendly and supportive team

• 

Possibility to work more than 50% by combining kayak guiding with shifts in other departments, depending on your experience and our operational needs

• 

We can assist with accommodation during the employment period

We're looking for someone who:

• 

is a certified kayak guide with sea kayaking experience

• 

has a full driving licence

• 

speaks fluent English

• 

is fit, reliable and comfortable working outdoors in changing weather

• 

is service-minded and good with people

• 

is available for the full period 15 June -- 15 August 2027

Additional advantages:

Hospitality experience, Scandinavian languages, photography are an advantage.

Interested?

Send your CV and a short introduction to blaz@reinerorbuer.no, including information about your kayak qualifications and previous guiding experience.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

At Reine Rorbuer resort, our guided kayak tours, hikes, photo tours and Northern Lights tours help guests experience the extraordinary landscape of Lofoten. Based in the fishing village of Reine, where the mountains meet the Arctic Ocean, we aim to make every activity as memorable for its warm, attentive service as for its setting.

We hold our activities to a high standard, and our guided kayak tours have earned a high guest satisfaction score. We're looking for people who take pride in that standard and are committed to giving every activity guest an outstanding experience.
